name: Martpart
description: As the Capital’s market district, it boasts diverse products and crowds of patrons. Lantern-lit stalls and culturally blended architecture adorn cobblestone streets, while a hidden underworld hosts secret trades and schemes. Despite Ironhand Army scrutiny, illicit activities persist in its darker alleys. At its core lies the Illu Die Arena, a magically lit battleground featuring taii’maku engineering that captivates crowds most nights. Beyond the market and arena, the district offers nightlife for all budgets, earning its reputation as the Capital’s sleepless quarter. Adventurers and mercenaries flock here to gain fame in the arena or find work—whether guarding merchants or engaging in shadier pursuits. Jobs like recovering stolen goods or smuggling are commonplace.
